title.zh: v2.0.13 阻塞解除：上游 GS-1 v2.1.5 落地按帧寻址的 note 事件（noteAt/noteOffAt），本仓已同步并把守卫翻转为「必须存在定时事件」
title.en: v2.0.13 Unblocked: upstream GS-1 v2.1.5 ships frame-addressed note events (noteAt/noteOffAt); the pin is synced and the guard flips to requiring them

highlights.zh: **上游实现了 §5.9 的提案**（GS-1 **v2.1.5 @ e073df5**，**ABI 仍为 8**）：`worklet-processor.js` 现在接受 `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` 并携带**绝对帧号**，内部维护按帧排序、上限 1024 条的队列，并在 `process()` 里**按事件切分渲染块**，因此事件落在它指定的那一帧而不是下一个 128 帧边界。`panic` 清空队列；非法帧号被忽略而不是当成 0；静音期间帧游标仍推进（否则静音结束后所有事件整体迟到）。
highlights.en: **Upstream implemented the §5.9 proposal** (GS-1 **v2.1.5 @ e073df5**, **ABI still 8**): `worklet-processor.js` now accepts `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` carrying an **absolute frame**, keeps a frame-sorted queue capped at 1024 entries, and **splits the render block at each due event**, so an event lands on the frame it names rather than on the next 128-frame boundary. A panic clears the queue; a malformed frame is ignored rather than treated as zero; the frame cursor advances while…

highlights.zh: **实测契约（已写进上游测试）**：声部起点恒为 `atFrame + 128`——一个渲染量子的**常数**延迟，且**与事件落在块内哪个位置无关**（`atFrame` = 0/100/128/200/384/500 全部如此），块内位置被逐样本保留。这个常数由 `ready` 消息的 `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames` **报告给宿主**，宿主提前寻址即可与采样精确的原生声部对齐，不必硬编码。上游新增 7 条测试，其中最关键的一条是**「早发/晚发消息产生逐样本相同的输出」**——这正是导出 parity 能成立的前提。
highlights.en: **The measured contract, pinned by upstream tests**: the voice starts at exactly `atFrame + 128` — a **constant** one-quantum latency that is **independent of where in the block the event falls** (`atFrame` = 0/100/128/200/384/500 all behave this way) — while the in-block position is preserved sample-exactly. That constant is **reported to the host** in the `ready` message as `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`, so a host can address events early and stay aligned with sample-accura…

highlights.zh: **本仓侧**：`scripts/sync-gs1.mjs --from ../synth` 单向同步完成（6 个文件重新哈希，22 项契约断言全绿）；`Gs1Host` 增加 `noteOnAt`/`noteOffAt` 与 `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`；`gs1Scheduling.test.ts` 的守卫**按设计自动翻转**——从「协议必须没有时间字段」变为「协议必须有定时事件对」。**顺带修掉一个真实缺陷**：同步脚本的 `pruneToManagedSet` 会删除不在清单里的文件，于是它**静默删掉了 `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`**——正是用来补上游许可缺口的那份；现在 `KEEP_FILES` 显式列出我们自己的文档。
highlights.en: **On this side**: the one-directional `sync-gs1.mjs --from ../synth` completed (six files re-hashed, all 22 contract assertions green); `Gs1Host` gained `noteOnAt`/`noteOffAt` and `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`; and the `gs1Scheduling.test.ts` guard **flipped automatically by design**, from \"the protocol must have no time field\" to \"the protocol must have the timed pair\". **A real defect was fixed along the way**: the sync script's `pruneToManagedSet` deletes anything not…
